Louisa Marguerite Christensen is a chief physician and Ph.D. at Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg Hospitals [^src1]. She serves as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], the steering group responsible for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database [^src1]. Through this role, she acts as a knowledge-based contributor to the development of clinical quality indicators and the broader quality development framework for atrial fibrillation treatment in Denmark [^src1]. Her involvement highlights the interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral composition of the AFDK program's leadership [^src1].
